description: A loft conversion with front and rear dormer windows, creating extra bedroom space in the roof of a semi-detached home on Moulsham Drive, Chelmsford.
note: House type (semi-detached) and photo credit (Charles David Casson estate agents) confirmed directly by the user.

caseStudy.text: The owners of 156 Moulsham Drive, a semi-detached home in Chelmsford, wanted to make better use of their roof space with a proper loft conversion.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE designed a loft conversion with front and rear dormer windows, adding bedroom space within the existing roofline.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Chelmsford City Council granted full planning permission for the scheme. A later resale listing (photography courtesy of Charles David Casson) shows the finished layout, including an open-plan kitchen/dining extension with roof lantern.
caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
